title: Bold Wolves of the Plains

texts.details: The prairie wolves have lost their fear of us, $N. Once they kept to the grass and hunted the hare and the swoop. Now they come down to the pens at Bloodhoof when the moon is up, and they take the kodo calves from their mothers. A calf lost is a herd lost, years from now. Go out onto the plains and cull the wolves. Eight should teach the rest to keep their distance.
texts.objectives: Kill 8 Prairie Wolves, then return to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
texts.progress: The calves cry out each night, and the wolves still prowl the plains. Do not come back until you have thinned them.
texts.completion: Eight fewer wolves, and the calves will sleep safely beside their mothers. You have done well for the herds and for the village. Take this, and the thanks of Bloodhoof with it.

idea: prairie wolves have grown bold and are taking kodo calves near Bloodhoof Village at night
